description: This file contains implementation of string processing functions related to numeric values, including conversions from strings to float, double, and boolean, as well as internal utilities for parsing integers with different bases, and functions for formatting integers and floating-point numbers.

methods.name: SimpleAtof
methods.description: Converts a string view to float, handling whitespace and overflow, returns success status.

methods.name: SimpleAtod
methods.description: Converts a string view to double, handling whitespace and overflow, returns success status.

methods.name: SimpleAtob
methods.description: Converts a string view to boolean, recognizing common true/false strings.

methods.name: safe_strto32_base
methods.description: Safely parses a string to int32_t with specified base.

methods.name: safe_strto64_base
methods.description: Safely parses a string to int64_t with specified base.

methods.name: safe_strto128_base
methods.description: Safely parses a string to int128 with specified base.

methods.name: safe_strtou32_base
methods.description: Safely parses a string to uint32_t with specified base.

methods.name: safe_strtou64_base
methods.description: Safely parses a string to uint64_t with specified base.

methods.name: safe_strtou128_base
methods.description: Safely parses a string to uint128 with specified base.
